summary: Defines an XML schema for a video fast update request, used in SIP systems to ask a sender for a fresh full video picture. It documents a method deployed by several vendors before this RFC. New implementations are discouraged from using it and should use the Full Intra Request in RTCP. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If a video call gets garbled, you ask the other side to send a whole new picture. This old method for asking is written down, but newer ways are better.
